title: Part 12
content_zh: Beyond philosophy, the Classic serves as a compressed encyclopedia: it names dynasties in order, recounts the stories of filial children, and urges diligence — all in verses a child can memorize before they can read them.
content_en: Beyond philosophy, the Classic serves as a compressed encyclopedia: it names dynasties in order, recounts the stories of filial children, and urges diligence — all in verses a child can memorize before they can read them.
